notes.title: New radio show plus other updates!
notes.content:
Hello!
We took the time to look at all your feedback and did a big update. The most noticeable one is a new radio show that was added in the hub area. 

[url=https://twitter.com/ludodrome]If you like the hub area you should follow Nate Berens <3[/url]
Updates:
[list]
[*]  Added the radio play (accessible once the games are unlocked in the Hub)
[*]  Added gamepad support
[*]  Added control remapping (including y-axis invert)
[*]  Added some new shots to the ending
[*]  Various small bug fixes
[/list]

For the radio show, we were so lucky to get amazing talent like Justin Whang and John Wolfe.
[url=https://twitter.com/DreadXP_/status/1411437318473404420]Here is a full list if you are curious[/url]

Thank you so much for the feedback! If you would like to give more on any of our games the best way for us to see it is the [b]#bugs-and-feedback [/b]channel in our Discord. We're still a small team so we can be slow to see comments here on Steam. [url=https://discord.gg/thGRBsu]You can join our Discord here [/url]

Thank you so much and hope you have an amazing day!
-Star
